title: Judicial deference to agency interpretation
question: How much weight does an agency’s reading of a statute get?

steps.note: Deference to an agency’s application of a statutory term to facts.
Same: “employee” under the NLRA; the Board’s reading stands if it has warrant in the record.
Respect according to the power to persuade.
Two steps: clear statute controls; otherwise a reasonable agency reading wins.
An agency may depart from a prior judicial reading of an ambiguous statute.
Step zero: Chevron applies only where Congress delegated authority to act with the force of law; ruling letters get Skidmore.
The Court decides questions of deep economic and political significance itself.
Auer deference narrowed: genuine ambiguity, reasonable reading, authoritative and expert.
Chevron overruled; courts exercise independent judgment, with Skidmore respect remaining.
